brief:
Turn any directory of content-addressed evidence bundles (root.json + graph.json per bundle) into a public chain page that re-derives every root in the reader's browser, draws the chain as a tree on a 64-vertex lattice, writes it out as seals, plays it as sound, and veils what each try found behind a members' build. Use when a research lane, benchmark lane or agent run has minted bundles and needs a page people can check without being asked to trust it, or when adding a new lane to an existing family of chain pages.

You have bundles; you want a page a stranger can check. The page is a **reader of the work, never part of it**: it names the root it was generated from and re-derives everything below that root on load.

- A lane has minted one bundle per entry, step or package (one `root.json` + `graph.json` each). - Someone asks "show this work", "give this lane a page", "add this chain to the others". - An existing engine builds several chains and a new lane should join without a code change.
